entities.summary: Oleksandr Viktorovych Yanukovych is a Russian businessman and son of the former President of Ukraine Viktor Yanukovych. He became one of the richest men in the country during his father's time in office, leading a group known as "the family" and a conglomerate called Management Assets Company (MAKO). Since the ouster as President of his father he has lived in Russia and has there been granted Russian citizenship.
